items.title: Ray Ricker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 27, 2022
items.q: And it was Horace Silver. And it had four tunes on it you know.

ctx.x: If you had gone out to a record store about that time when you were playing the hockey rink gig, what might you have purchased as far as non-classical music?

Non-classical. I remember pretty much my first one I got was a ten inch 33-1/3 — no a ten — or it was the small one, not the — maybe the big one was the ten inch. I don’t know. But this was the smaller one. And it was Horace Silver. And it had four tunes on it you know. And that was the first one I got. After that I joined the Columbia Record Archive you know, the whatever, the one where you got a record every month and they just came. And sometimes you got to choose you know. But there were a lot of guys that…
Do you recall when you started figuring out the mystery of chord symbols and how they might apply to your improvising?
